author: CourtneyDN
body:
Right now it is a tie between California Vintage Wine Bistro & Stone Groove Stillhouse (both in Anaheim.)

I consider them both 'nice' places so we're definitely not there as often as we like but they're great!

author: aleckscasablancs
body: I love Earnest from CA Vintage Wine bistro. He’s the best and the food/wine is awesome.
